events.title: We have a release date!
events.summary: Hello fellow gold miners!I just wanted to update everyone with the date the game will enter Early Access.Paystreak enters Early Access on November 12 at 18:00 UTC (2026)6 PM UK · 7 PM CET · 1 PM ET · 10 AM PT · 5 AM AEDT (Nov 13)So make sure to have your shovels ready to dig for gold all day long.In other news, Paystreak will be participating in Steam Next Fest, hopefully we get some more miners to compete with on the leaderboard.Thanks all for playing!/ Sebastian

events.title: Demo update 0.3.0
events.summary: Demo update 0.3.0 Dev noteI still get reports about diggers going idle and only digging one layer. This is an option to turn on in GAMEPLAY in SETTINGS. Also a gold panner will only collect gold from a wash plant that is linked to the room, so click a gold room and click the LINK/PAIR button. I get a few reports about game crashes. events.title: We just hit 1,000 miners!
events.summary: Hi all, We just hit 1000 miners!Paystreak passed 1000 wishlists this weekend. Thank you to everyone who added it, played the demo, or just stopped by the page.The best part of the new crowd has been the flood of ideas and bug reports. Some of them I had never thought of, some of them I had hoped nobody would find. Either way it means more work for me, and that is exactly the kind of work I want.
